backend/main.mo: Initializes an actor and mixes in blob storage functionality via MixinStorage.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature evidence reports linking features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for various frontend files describing styling, components, and page behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base layers and defines light/dark OKLCH color tokens and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO tags and preload hints for fonts and critical hero/menu images.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with lazy‑loaded pages, shared layout, and search validation.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Renders the brand logo with size variants and a text fallback on image load failure.
frontend/src/components/CustomerReviewsS: Displays customer reviews with star ratings, cards, and a link to Google reviews.
frontend/src/components/GalleryImage.tsx: Gallery image component with loading shimmer, error fallback, and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/GetDirectionsBar: Sticky directions bar with location info and a button linking to Google Maps.
frontend/src/components/HeaderSearch.tsx: Header search form with local state, input field, and submit callback.
frontend/src/components/LogoMotif.tsx: Renders a logo image with size variants and falls back to a text motif if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/MenuCategoryCaro: Displays a swipeable, keyboard-navigable carousel of menu categories with item listings and navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/MenuScreenshotGa: Shows a gallery with a primary screenshot viewer, including loading and error fallbacks for images.
frontend/src/components/Section.tsx: A layout wrapper component that applies consistent section spacing and container styling.
frontend/src/components/Seo.tsx: Dynamically updates document title and SEO meta tags including description and Open Graph fields.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the website footer with branding, social links, navigation shortcuts, and contact information.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Provides the site header with branding, navigation, search, CTAs, and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/WatermarkBackgro: Loads and displays layered watermark background images after a short delay for visual depth.
frontend/src/data/customerReviews.ts: Exports static customer review data and a Google Reviews URL for display in the app.
frontend/src/data/menuData.ts: Defines menu item and category types and exports structured menu data for shakes, juices, salads, papad, and soups.
frontend/src/draft24-exclusions.md: Explains which draft changes were excluded and documents the restored Draft 24 feature set including gallery, routing, design system, and UI/UX details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useHorizontalSwipe.ts: Provides a hook that detects horizontal swipe gestures and triggers left or right handlers.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, login flow, identity persistence, and provider logic using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks; currently exports nothing.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up global styles, fonts, Tailwind layers, and light/dark mode color tokens for the site's design system.
frontend/src/lib/bookingLinks.ts: Exports a constant containing the Zomato table booking URL.
frontend/src/lib/brandAssets.ts: Defines paths for logo, hero images, watermark assets, and gallery images used across the site.
frontend/src/lib/directions.ts: Exports a constant Google Maps directions URL for the restaurant.
frontend/src/lib/globalSearchContent.ts: Implements search indexing across menu items, offers, and pages using normalized text matching. Returns structured SearchResult objects with links and metadata.
frontend/src/lib/menuPdf.ts: Empty placeholder file for future menu PDF-related utilities.
frontend/src/lib/menuPrice.ts: Formats menu item prices, handling numeric values, labels, and fallbacks. Returns properly formatted price strings with rupee symbols.
frontend/src/lib/menuScreenshotAssets.ts: Exports an ordered list of optimized menu screenshot asset URLs. Used to display menu pages in a fixed, deterministic order.
frontend/src/lib/orderOnlineLinks.ts: Provides centralized online ordering URLs for Zomato and Swiggy. Ensures consistent use across the site.
frontend/src/lib/socialLinks.ts: Defines shared social media URLs including Instagram, Facebook, and Google. Serves as a single source of truth for external profile links.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, Internet Identity provider, and React Query. Renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the restaurant's About page with story, values, and SEO metadata. Includes styled sections highlighting cuisine, quality, hygiene, and family focus.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact details, map info, quick actions, and SEO metadata. Provides location, phone, hours, and links for ordering and directions.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Empty placeholder component for the gallery page.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Implements the homepage with hero section, cuisines, highlights, and booking/ordering actions. Includes SEO tags and visual brand assets.
frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx: Menu page with search-based filtering, screenshot gallery, category carousel, and CTA, updating URL query on search.
frontend/src/pages/OffersPage.tsx: Displays promotional offers with icons, badges, and terms, using styled cards and SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Global search page that queries menu, offers, and pages, rendering grouped results and updating URL search params.
frontend/src/types/pdf-lib-global.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file placeholder for pdf-lib global types.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, shadows, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking issues, image optimization requirements, and existing feature metadata.
